facts.text: Melanie expressed gratitude towards her family for providing support during difficult times.

evidence.quote: Having my fam around helps a lot. It makes hard times easier.
They're my biggest motivation and support.

facts.text: Melanie shared a photograph of herself and a child walking on a trail, which Caroline complimented.

evidence.quote: image: a photography of a woman and a child walking on a trail
Wow, great pic! Is that recent? Looks like you all had fun!

facts.text: Melanie confirmed that the photograph was taken the previous day, following a road trip.

evidence.quote: we just did it yesterday! The kids loved it and it was a nice way to relax after the road trip.
